senses.gloss:
अज्यानि अ-ज्यानि, इस्, f., Ved. undecaying
nature.

अज्येष्ठ अ-ज्येष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, not the oldest
or best; having no elder brother.
—अज्येष्ठ-वृत्ति,
इस्, इस्, इ, not behaving as the eldest brother ought to
behave, or (अज्येष्ठ-वृत्ति) behaving like one who
has no elder brother.

आज्य आज्य, अम्, n. (fr. rt. अञ्ज् with आ),
melted or clarified butter used for oblations, or for
pouring into the holy fire at the sacrifice, or for
anointing anything sacrificed or offered; (in a wider
[]
sense) oil and milk used instead of clarified butter
at a sacrifice; N. of a sort of chant or religious
service; turpentine.
—आज्य-प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
drinking the clarified butter; (आस्), m. pl. a class of
Manes who are the sons of Pulastya and the ancestors
of the Vaiśya order.
—आज्य-पात्र, अम्, n. a vessel
or dish to hold clarified butter.
—आज्य-भाग, अस्,
m. a portion of clarified butter; (औ), m. du. the
two portions of clarified butter belonging to Agni
and Soma; (अस्, आ, अम्), partaking of the clarified
butter; offering clarified butter at certain ceremonies.
—आज्य-भुज्, क्, m. ‘consumer of clarified butter,’
epithet of Agni.
—आज्य-वारि, इस्, m. ‘sea of clarified
butter,’ one of the seven seas.
—आज्य-स्थाली, f.,
see आज्य-पात्र.
